levels.name: Two-touch, each foot
levels.how: 3 m from the wall. Pass with the inside of the foot, control with one touch, pass again. Right foot, then left. Soft ankle, ball on the ground.
levels.mistake: Stabbing at the ball with a stiff foot
levels.fix: Soft ankle, cushion it, then pass

levels.name: One-touch, each foot
levels.how: Pass back first time with the same foot. Keep a steady rhythm and pass firmly.
levels.mistake: Letting the ball stop before you strike
levels.fix: Strike it as it comes back, keep the feet moving

levels.name: One-touch, alternating feet
levels.how: Right foot, then left, one touch each time. Step to the ball with the foot that is next.
levels.fix: Alternate every pass, even if the left is slower

levels.name: Inside to outside
levels.how: Receive with the inside of the foot, take it away with the outside of the same foot, play it back. Both feet.
levels.mistake: Taking the second touch with a flat foot
levels.fix: Open the foot: inside, then roll over to the outside

levels.name: Half-turn off the wall
levels.how: Pass in, check your shoulder, receive side-on and turn away from an imaginary defender, then play forward to a target.
levels.fix: Open your body before the ball arrives

levels.name: Bounce and aerial
levels.how: Lift or throw the ball against the wall and control it out of the air with thigh, chest or instep, then play it back.
levels.mistake: Sticking the leg out like a tree trunk
levels.fix: Match the ball's speed and draw the foot back as it lands

levels.name: Step back, driven and long
levels.how: Move back 2 m, then play driven and long passes. Plant beside the ball, lock the ankle, chest over it.
levels.mistake: Leaning back so the ball sails high
levels.fix: Plant beside the ball, strike the middle, follow through low

levels.name: Called touches
levels.how: The app calls ONE or TWO: use that many touches before passing back.
levels.mistake: Using the wrong number of touches
levels.fix: Listen, then play exactly that many

source.label: W-A, W-B, W-C wall sessions (YouTube Club Kick, TikTok @aaron_at)

levels.name: One touch through the gate
levels.how: Two cones a big step apart, a partner serving. One touch through the gate with the right foot, then to the right of the cones; switch to the left. Swap roles.
levels.fix: Pass to your partner's correct foot, hard and on the ground

levels.name: Two touches, then one
levels.how: Two touches to the side of the cone, then a one-touch pass; alternate two-touch and one-touch, then go the other way.
levels.mistake: Touching the ball into your own feet
levels.fix: Touch into space, keep it on the ground

levels.name: Drop, check and fast feet
levels.how: Pass one-touch, drop back while checking your shoulder, receive with two touches to the left, then fast feet through a small box and pass one-touch.
levels.fix: Check your shoulder every time before the ball comes

source.label: PP1 to PP3 (YouTube Prolific Soccer)

levels.name: Inside and outside
levels.how: 8 to 10 cones about a ball-width apart. Inside touch, outside touch with one foot round each cone.
levels.mistake: Pushing the ball too far ahead
levels.fix: Small touches, ball always within a stride

levels.name: Right foot only
levels.how: Weave the line using only the right foot.
levels.mistake: Switching to the left when it gets hard
levels.fix: Stay on the weaker foot and slow down

levels.name: Left foot only
levels.how: Weave the line using only the left foot.
levels.mistake: Switching to the right when it gets hard
levels.fix: Stay on the weaker foot and slow down

levels.name: Tight touches
levels.how: A touch on every step, close control at speed. Right foot, then left.
levels.fix: A touch with every step, ball close to the body

levels.name: Rollover
levels.how: Sole roll across each cone, switching feet.
levels.fix: Look up between rolls

levels.name: Push and pull
levels.how: Push the ball forward with the sole, pull it back, then change direction round the cone.
levels.fix: Pull back, then push out of the turn at pace

source.label: DR1 cone weave set (YouTube GCFC Training)

levels.name: Sole roll
levels.how: The underside of the foot just below the toes grabs the top of the ball. Roll it to the other foot and back.
levels.fix: Light touch, roll it, keep the ball moving

levels.name: Roll stop
levels.how: Roll the ball further across the body; the other foot stops it on top and rolls it back.
levels.fix: Roll it softly so the other foot can stop it

levels.name: Brazilian taps
levels.how: Tap with the sole of one foot, hop, tap with the other, wrapping around the opposite leg. Start slowly.
levels.fix: Slow first, then speed up

levels.name: Push and pull
levels.how: Push forward with the sole, drag back with the same foot. Exchange feet with a hop. Use your arms for balance.
levels.fix: Stay on the toes, find a rhythm

levels.name: Sole square
levels.how: Draw a square with the ball: push forward, across, exchange feet, drag back, across. Switch direction halfway.
levels.mistake: Skipping a side of the square
levels.fix: Say the sides in your head: forward, across, back, across

source.label: Sole roll mastery skills (YouTube 7mlc)

levels.name: Drop juggles
levels.how: Drop the ball from your hands, kick it up once, catch it. Both feet. Learn how hard to kick. Toe forward, standing leg slightly bent.
levels.mistake: Missing the centre of the ball
levels.fix: Centre of the foot on the centre of the ball

levels.name: Bounce juggles
levels.how: One bounce between each touch. Work towards 100 in a row.
levels.fix: Hit it straight up so it comes back to you

levels.name: Full juggles
levels.how: Drop it from your hands, then keep it up with both feet, close so you do not need to move.
levels.fix: Low and controlled, a hand's width off the foot

levels.name: The flicker
levels.how: Sole on the ball, roll it back, get the toes under it and flick it up without hands.
levels.fix: Roll back first, toes under, then flick

levels.name: Thigh juggling
levels.how: Contact with the thigh, the knee at 90 degrees to the body. Mix with the feet.
levels.mistake: Using the knee instead of the thigh
levels.fix: Keep the thigh flat, knee bent to 90

levels.name: Maradona 7
levels.how: Seven touches without a drop: right foot, right thigh, right shoulder, head, left shoulder, left thigh, left foot.
levels.fix: Keep the ball high enough to get under it

source.label: Juggling for beginners (YouTube Daniel Meyn Football)

levels.name: Use the ground
levels.how: Let it bounce and stop it with the sole as it comes up. Protect it at once: body between the defender and the ball, then turn.
levels.mistake: Trying to catch it on the full
levels.fix: Let it bounce once, the ground is your friend

levels.name: Thigh
levels.how: The thigh takes the pace off. Put the ball down at your feet, not back up in the air.
levels.mistake: Stabbing at it with a stiff leg
levels.fix: Give with the thigh as it lands

levels.name: Directional control
levels.how: Instead of killing it, control it into the direction you want: a touch away, or keep it up and juggle.
levels.mistake: Killing the ball dead every time
levels.fix: Take it where you want to go

levels.name: Foot trap
levels.how: Match the ball's speed: as it comes down, your foot comes down, ankle locked, then draw back so it kisses your foot. Start with low tosses, then higher.
levels.mistake: Sticking the leg out like a tree trunk
levels.fix: Foot comes down with the ball, then draws back

source.label: How to control any ball out of the air (YouTube Unisport)

levels.name: Half turn
levels.how: A square of 4 cones two steps apart, 4 steps from a wall. Pass in, check into the square, scan, open your body and take it across, then play to a target.
levels.mistake: Staying static so the defender steps in
levels.fix: Check into the square, scan, then turn

levels.name: Barcelona turn
levels.how: Open up as if half-turning, then go the other way with the next touch. Scan before the ball returns.
levels.fix: Open as if to turn, then change the other way

levels.name: Dummy turn
levels.how: When the scan shows space behind you: body feint towards the ball (drop the knee and shoulder), let it roll past and spin after it.
levels.mistake: Stopping the ball on the spot
levels.fix: Let it run past you, then spin onto it

levels.name: Cruyff turn
levels.how: Fake a pass or strike, then hook the ball behind your standing leg with the inside of the same foot.
levels.mistake: Dropping your head after the fake
levels.fix: Sell the fake, then hook it quickly

levels.name: De Jong turn
levels.how: With the defender tight: bait with a first touch slightly across the body using the inside of the foot, then go the other way.
levels.mistake: Making the bait touch too big
levels.fix: Small bait touch, then change direction fast

levels.name: Called turn
levels.how: Scan, and the app calls SPACE BEHIND (dummy or half turn) or MAN ON (play it back, or De Jong or Cruyff the other way).
levels.mistake: Choosing the turn before the call
levels.fix: Scan first, then pick the turn the call asks for

source.label: 5 turns every midfielder should master (YouTube 7mlc)

families.name: Snapshot finishing

levels.name: Snapshot
levels.how: Cones as defenders just outside the box. Start light on your feet, shift the ball just outside your body into a gap and strike at once. Getting it on target quickly beats a perfect corner.
levels.mistake: Waiting between the shift and the shot
levels.fix: No delay: shift, then shoot

levels.name: Hesitation snapshot
levels.how: Shift as if to shoot, take an extra touch past the second cone, then shoot. Getting it on target quickly beats a perfect corner.
levels.fix: Show the shot, take the extra touch, then strike

levels.name: V-cut snapshot
levels.how: Shift, fake, drag back 45 degrees with the sole, swap feet and push into space with the inside of the other foot, then shoot. Getting it on target quickly beats a perfect corner.
levels.fix: Short drag, swap feet, then shoot

levels.name: Sole roll snapshot
levels.how: Shift, fake with a raised opposite arm and slight backlift, sole roll across, then shoot. Getting it on target quickly beats a perfect corner.
levels.fix: Raise the arm, small backlift, then roll

levels.name: Double cut snapshot
levels.how: Shift, slight backlift to get defenders on their heels, chop with the inside of the striking foot, transfer to the other foot, then shoot. Getting it on target quickly beats a perfect corner.
levels.fix: Backlift first, then chop and transfer

levels.name: Croqueta snapshot
levels.how: From behind the cones, inside-to-inside transfer, push into space with the outside of the other foot, then shoot. Getting it on target quickly beats a perfect corner.
levels.fix: Quick inside to inside, then push away

levels.name: Fake shot snapshot
levels.how: Shift with the outside of the foot, fake the shot by raising the striking leg, cut, then shoot. Getting it on target quickly beats a perfect corner.
levels.fix: Head up, show the shot, then cut

levels.name: Inside-outside snapshot
levels.how: Push past the first cone at 45 degrees with the inside, transfer to the outside of the same foot, then shoot. Getting it on target quickly beats a perfect corner.
levels.fix: Small push, then take it with the outside

levels.name: Double croqueta snapshot
levels.how: Croqueta round the first cone, then a second one, then shoot. Getting it on target quickly beats a perfect corner.
levels.fix: Two quick transfers, then strike

levels.name: Fake shot and croqueta
levels.how: Outside shift, fake the shot, croqueta, then shoot. Getting it on target quickly beats a perfect corner.
levels.fix: Fake, croqueta, strike in one rhythm

source.label: Snapshot finishing family (YouTube 7mlc, striker training)

families.note: At most 6 to 8 shots the day before a game.

levels.name: Partner down and back
levels.how: A partner tosses from close range, you volley back into their hands, working down the field. Lots of controlled reps.
levels.fix: Lock the ankle and make clean contact

levels.name: Self-toss, one bounce
levels.how: Toss up, let it bounce once, volley into a goal or at a wall. Vary the height and angle.
levels.fix: Strike it at knee height

levels.name: Self-toss, no bounce
levels.how: Toss up and finish before it lands. In a match the ball often comes straight through the air.
levels.fix: Chest over the ball, knee over it

levels.name: Juggle then volley
levels.how: Juggle, play a high ball up, then finish before it lands. Partner version: toss over your back, turn and shoot.
levels.mistake: Taking your eyes off the ball
levels.fix: Eyes on the ball until contact

levels.name: Cross or lob, first time
levels.how: A partner crosses or lobs it and you finish first time. Easier: allow one bounce, or use a toss.
levels.fix: Hit it first time, laces or inside of the foot

source.label: 5 exercises to improve volleys (YouTube 360Player)

levels.name: Placement (inside)
levels.how: Inside of the foot, aim low across the keeper. Learn this one first.
levels.fix: Open the foot and strike through the middle

levels.name: Power (laces)
levels.how: 3 to 4 long strides straight at the ball. Plant foot points at the target, knee slightly bent, big backswing, chest over the ball.
levels.fix: Foot back to hip height, chest over the ball

levels.name: Curl (instep)
levels.how: Approach at 45 degrees, plant beside the ball, strike a little below the middle with the instep and twist the hips.
levels.fix: Come in at 45 degrees and wrap around the ball

levels.name: Trivela (outside)
levels.how: When the ball is on your weak side, strike it with the outside of your strong foot instead of switching feet. Approach at 45 degrees.
levels.fix: Use the outside of your strong foot

levels.name: Half volley
levels.how: Strike on the bounce, as low to the ground as possible. Eyes on the middle of the ball, plant foot facing the target.
levels.fix: Strike down through the bounce

source.label: 5 shooting techniques explained (YouTube 7mlc)

levels.name: 3-point start
levels.how: One hand on the ground, sprint out for 10 m. Drive the knees, stay low.
levels.fix: Stay low for the first 3 to 4 steps

levels.name: Falling start
levels.how: Stand tall on the balls of the feet, lean forward as one stiff line until you fall, then sprint.
levels.fix: Lean as one stiff line from head to heels

levels.name: Side-step start
levels.how: Stand side-on, take a small lateral step, then sprint.
levels.fix: Small step, then drive

levels.name: 180 turn start
levels.how: Face backwards, jump-turn 180 degrees off both feet, then sprint. For turning to chase a ball over the top.
levels.fix: Jump-turn and drive in one move

levels.name: Floating start
levels.how: A slow rolling run-in, then accelerate between two cones. For a change of pace when already jogging.
levels.fix: Float, then burst at the cones

levels.name: Reactive start
levels.how: Stand ready. The app calls GO at a random moment. React, do not anticipate.
levels.fix: Wait for the call, then go

source.label: S1 sprint starts (YouTube FootballFitnessBootcamp)

levels.name: Zig-zag sprint
levels.how: Cones 6 steps apart in a zig-zag. Sprint, drop your inside shoulder round each cone, tight feet, explode out. Finish with a 5 to 10 m sprint.
levels.fix: Drop the inside shoulder and keep the feet tight

levels.name: Zig-zag shuffle
levels.how: Side shuffle through the same zig-zag. Stay low, low centre of gravity.
levels.fix: Stay low the whole way

levels.name: Backpedal and forward
levels.how: Backpedal to a cone, then run forward. Get your hips low, arms with the legs, push off hard.
levels.fix: Chest over the toes, short steps

levels.name: Hip switch
levels.how: Move at speed backwards and switch the hips. Defenders mostly track backwards or sideways.
levels.fix: Turn only the hips, keep the shoulders square

levels.name: Crossover and turn
levels.how: Sideways angle, cross the feet, plant, switch the hips, look over your shoulder, plant and go. Stay low.
levels.fix: Cross low, plant, then turn and go

levels.name: Jockey a wall ball
levels.how: Play a pass off the wall and jockey backwards as it returns: light on the toes, switching hips. When it reaches you, step forward with a touch.
levels.fix: Stay patient and contain, step in only at the end

source.label: How to become an elite defender, CB3 (YouTube Prolific Soccer, 7mlc)

families.name: Tackling ladder

levels.name: Interception reads
levels.how: Partner receives, you stay goal side. Step in front when they are flat-footed after checking in. Win it before they settle.
levels.fix: Read the trigger, then step in front

levels.name: Jab and poke
levels.how: 1v1 in a channel, side-on and low. Jab to provoke a reaction; poke the ball only after a jab, with both feet.
levels.fix: Jab first, poke only if the ball stays

levels.name: Block tackle and second ball
levels.how: Static ball first, then walking pace. Contact with the inside of the foot, body behind the ball, never from behind. After contact, sprint to the loose ball.
levels.fix: Inside of the foot, body behind the ball

source.label: How risky are your tackles (YouTube Beestera Soccer)

families.note: No slide tackle: practising it alone does not help.

levels.name: Close down the wall ball
levels.how: Throw the ball against a wall, sprint to close the rebound as it travels, brake into a jockey stance 1 to 2 m from it, step in and win it, then pass to a cone within 4 s.
levels.fix: Brake, then jockey side-on

levels.name: Curved press
levels.how: A ball on a cone is the carrier, a second cone is the passing lane. From 10 to 15 m sprint on a curve so your body blocks the lane, brake side-on 1 to 2 m away, show the touchline, step in.
levels.fix: Curve the run and block the lane

levels.name: Recovery run
levels.how: Start facing upfield 20 m from a cone goal. On the app's TURN call, turn, sprint back on a curve to the goal side of an imaginary attacker, then brake into a jockey stance.
levels.fix: Curve to the goal side, then brake

source.label: D7, PR1, recovery runs (YouTube Hidden Play Football, Football IQ)

levels.name: 3v1
levels.how: Four players, a square about 10 yards. The defender wins it, the outside players keep it. Two-touch.
levels.fix: Pass, then move to a new angle

levels.name: 4v1
levels.how: Five players, a square about 8 yards. Fewer touches, quicker decisions. Mandatory two-touch forces firm passes.
levels.fix: Firm, quick passes

levels.name: 4v1, tight
levels.how: Square down to 6 yards, one-touch.
levels.fix: Scan before it arrives

levels.name: 5v2
levels.how: Seven players, a bigger square. Keep it with two defenders on.
levels.fix: Spread out and keep the shape

source.label: 6 best soccer rondo drills (YouTube Paul Spacey)

levels.name: 1v1 wide
levels.how: A wide channel, one attacker, one defender. Attack, beat, finish or cross.
levels.fix: Pick your move before you reach the defender

levels.name: 1v1 central
levels.how: The same in a central area, finishing at goal.
levels.fix: Beat the defender first, then shoot

levels.name: 3v3 with shooting zones
levels.how: 3v3 in a marked area with mini goals. Shots only from the shooting zones in front of each goal.
levels.fix: Work the ball into the zone

source.label: SSG1, SSG2 (YouTube coachbetter, Jose Silva Caparros)

families.name: Fast feet

levels.name: Forwards, in and out
levels.how: Imagine a ladder on the floor. Two feet in forwards, one foot in forwards, in and outs. Stay on your toes, arms drive with the feet.
levels.fix: Stay on the toes, quick and light

levels.name: Sideways
levels.how: Two feet in sideways, lateral in and out, icky shuffle and backwards icky shuffle, crossover.
levels.fix: Head up, arms in rhythm

levels.name: Hops and hips
levels.how: Foot exchange, reverse crossover, hip twists, carioca, two-footed and one-footed hops.
levels.fix: Slow down and keep the rhythm

source.label: 15 fast footwork exercises (YouTube 7mlc)

families.note: Follow with a 10 to 20 m acceleration.

families.name: Warm-up 11+ style

levels.name: Level 1
levels.how: Part 1: slow running with active stretching. Part 2: bench (plank), single-leg stance, squats with toe raises, lateral jumps. Part 3: running across the pitch, plant and cut.
levels.fix: Control every rep, land softly

levels.name: Level 2
levels.how: Same three parts: side bench, single-leg stance throwing a ball to a partner or the wall, wall jumps, bounding, plant and cut at speed.
levels.fix: Knee over the middle toe on every landing

levels.name: Level 3
levels.how: Same three parts: bench with leg lift, single-leg balance with a partner pushing, box jumps, bounding, plant and cut at 80 percent.
levels.mistake: Going to the next level too soon
levels.fix: Move up only when the level below feels easy

source.label: FIFA 11+ (manual, sponet, PMC12371935)

families.note: The day before a game and on match day, only the running parts.

levels.name: Get familiar
levels.how: Juggle forcing the weak foot at least every other touch (R-L-R-L), then R-L-L-R-L-L. Then small dribbles across the pitch mainly with the weak foot.
levels.mistake: Always going back to the strong foot
levels.fix: Make the weak foot do most of the work

levels.name: Wall passing
levels.how: Pass against the wall with the weak foot only, receive with it only.
levels.fix: Slow and accurate first, then speed up

levels.name: Power and accuracy
levels.how: Target practice at a small goal (body position, plant foot, leg swing), then longer range, aiming at the crossbar.
levels.fix: Plant beside the ball and strike the middle

source.label: How to improve your weak foot (YouTube Unisport)

levels.name: Comfortable distance
levels.how: Three targets spread apart, a wall to receive from. Look over your shoulder, receive, first touch, pick a target, long pass. Start at a distance where every pass is clean.
levels.mistake: Hitting it as hard as you can
levels.fix: Make every rep game-like and accurate

levels.name: Demanding distance
levels.how: Move the targets back, only so far that you can still hit a good pass every time. 50 to 100 reps in total, both feet.
levels.fix: Only as far as you can stay accurate

levels.name: Called target
levels.how: As the ball comes back off the wall, the app calls LEFT, MIDDLE or RIGHT. Pick that target and play the long pass.
levels.fix: Wait for the call, then pick

source.label: Easy way to improve long passing alone (YouTube Unisport)

levels.name: Mirror shuffle
levels.how: Face a partner in an athletic stance. One leads with shuffles forwards, back and sideways, the other mirrors. Switch roles each round.
levels.fix: Watch the hips and react

levels.name: Mirror on a cone line
levels.how: A line of 4 cones between you. The follower mirrors the leader's shuffles and cuts along the line, low and wide.
levels.fix: Stay low in an athletic stance

source.label: RA1, RA2 (YouTube uoasportsagility, Beyondriven)

levels.name: Solo, one cone
levels.how: One cone as the defender. Run at it, beat it with one move, accelerate away.
levels.fix: Do the move at speed, then explode

levels.name: Solo, gates and finish
levels.how: Cone gates, a move at each, then a finish.
levels.fix: Eyes up out of the last gate, shoot early

levels.name: Called direction
levels.how: The app calls LEFT or RIGHT. React and go the other way.
levels.fix: React to the cue, don't guess

levels.name: Partner, passive defender
levels.how: Attack a partner who stays passive. Learn to read their feet.
levels.mistake: Going before you read the defender
levels.fix: Read their feet, then choose

levels.name: Partner, live feint
levels.how: Run at the defender, fake one way, push the ball past on the other side with the outside of the foot and accelerate. Goals out of 3, then swap.
levels.fix: Fake, change pace, then go

levels.name: Race to goal
levels.how: Side by side: a ladder or fast feet, an explosive dribble, then a finish. Win the race.
levels.fix: Tight ball control, then win the race

levels.name: Called move
levels.how: Run at a cone. The app calls one of your signature moves (pick 2 or 3 on the Skill moves card). Do it at the cone and accelerate away.
levels.mistake: Doing a move you have not practised
levels.fix: Stick to your 2 or 3 best moves

source.label: B1, V1 to V4 (YouTube Football Class, Coach to Coach, TotalFootball Studio, SoccerExercises)

levels.name: The lift (on the wing, little space)
levels.how: Lift the ball down the line past the defender. The ball in the air avoids an outstretched leg.
levels.fix: Flick it just past the foot

levels.name: Cruyff turn (faking a cross)
levels.how: Shape to cross, then cut the ball behind your standing leg with the inside of the foot.
levels.fix: Sell the cross, then cut it back

levels.name: Puskas (defender reaches in)
levels.how: Pull back with the sole, then push away with the inside of the foot.
levels.fix: Quick pull, quick push

levels.name: Fake cross (wide 1v1)
levels.how: Touch to the side, shape for a big cross, drag past with the inside of the foot.
levels.fix: Show the cross, then drag past

levels.name: Inside-out (facing up)
levels.how: Drag across the body with the inside, wrap round, push the other way with the top of the foot.
levels.fix: Short drag, then push the other way

levels.name: Fake cut-back (running the channel)
levels.how: At speed, stop the ball briefly with the outside, then push down the line with the inside of the same foot.
levels.fix: Brief stop, then drive down the line

levels.name: Change of speed
levels.how: Slow as you near the defender, then accelerate suddenly. Needs good acceleration.
levels.fix: Slow early, then burst

levels.name: Underfoot stop (defender catching up)
levels.how: Stop dead with the sole, then pass or change direction.
levels.fix: Stop as the defender arrives

levels.name: Drop your shoulder (facing a defender)
levels.how: Drop the shoulder and step as if going one way, push the other way with the top of the foot.
levels.mistake: Dropping the shoulder with no step
levels.fix: Shoulder and step together, then go the other way

levels.name: La croqueta (tight spaces)
levels.how: Inside-to-inside transfer across the body.
levels.fix: Small, quick transfer

source.label: 10 easy skill moves to beat defenders (YouTube AllAttack)

levels.name: One-two and turn
levels.how: One cone in the centre, two gates about 10 strides either side. Dribble to the centre, play a one-two off the wall, take the first touch towards one gate in your stride, turn 180 degrees and come back. Both feet.
levels.fix: Take the ball in your stride and turn at pace

levels.name: Lateral weave
levels.how: Cones on a diagonal at very acute angles. Nudge the ball with the outside of the foot, light on your feet.
levels.fix: Light touches, razor-sharp control

levels.name: Ball shuttle
levels.how: 4 cones about 10 yards apart. Ball to cone 1, stop it, run to cone 2 and back; ball to cone 3, run to cone 4 and back; ball to the last cone, there and back; final ball back to the start, stopped dead. About 80 percent.
levels.fix: Steady aerobic pace, you can still talk

source.label: Individual fullback training (YouTube 7mlc)

families.name: Centre-back drills

levels.name: Pass, backpedal, weighted pass
levels.how: A clean first touch, a weighted pass across, then backpedal between reps for footwork coordination.
levels.fix: Short steps, stay on the toes

source.label: Individual centre back training (YouTube 7mlc)

families.note: The header drill is not here: headers are capped (10 a session, one session a week).

levels.name: Three-cone ball mastery
levels.how: One centre cone, one left and one right. A ball mastery combination in the middle (outside to inside, exchange feet), sole roll round the outside cone, back to the middle. 5 sets each side.
levels.fix: Smooth and controlled first

levels.name: 360 control
levels.how: 4 cones in a square with one in the centre. Dribble round a corner cone and back to the centre, then the next corner. After a full lap, repeat with the other foot.
levels.fix: A touch every step, ball close to the body

levels.name: Aerial touch and turn
levels.how: A square with a gate on each side. Pop the ball up after a few juggles, take a directional first touch to one gate, turn sharply, cross to the other gate, turn, return.
levels.fix: Take it where you want to go, then turn

source.label: Individual midfielder training (YouTube 7mlc)

levels.name: Obstacle course
levels.how: 8 cones, 4 balls. Inside touch, outside touch, a touch round the cones, onto the ball, then guide it with the inside of the foot into the far high-percentage area. Then mirror with the other foot.
levels.fix: Inside-foot placement first

levels.name: Second row
levels.how: Fake with the outside of the right foot, drag onto the left and shoot across goal. Next ball: inside touch, outside touch, sole on top, drag into space, slot near post. Now laces are allowed.
levels.fix: Inside-foot placement first, then add laces once warm

levels.name: Check into space
levels.how: Check back into space, take the ball with the inside of the foot, inside hook, slot near post. Next ball: push into space, hook back, push between two cones, far side.
levels.fix: Check into the space to create half a yard

levels.name: Near-post run
levels.how: Wall pass wide, then sprint diagonally to the near post in the defender's blind spot and finish a self-served ball low and first time. Call NEAR as you start.
levels.fix: Start behind the defender, then cut across in front

levels.name: Far-post run
levels.how: Start near the penalty spot out of the defender's reach, then run diagonally to the far post as the cross is delivered. Finish with your feet.
levels.fix: Stay hidden, then arrive late

levels.name: Called run
levels.how: The app calls NEAR or FAR as you start the run. Alternating the two confuses defenders.
levels.mistake: Running the same run every time
levels.fix: Listen, then make that run

source.label: Striker footwork (Alan Russell, YouTube 7mlc); near and far post runs (Dribble Dreams Academy)

levels.name: Swinger
levels.how: The whipped, curling cross. Plant foot a little away from the ball, swing the foot and strike the side of the ball a little below the middle with the instep. Follow through. Aim in front of the keeper.
levels.mistake: Planting too close to the ball
levels.fix: Plant a little away so you can swing through

levels.name: Floater
levels.how: The lofted, hanging cross. Plant beside the ball and strike with the very front of the forefoot, like chipping a golf ball. Aim for the back post.
levels.fix: Use the front of the forefoot and lift it

levels.name: Low cross
levels.how: Driven along the ground into the cut-back zone. Point the planted foot slightly off line. Check the exact contact point with a coach.
levels.mistake: Missing the ball with a long stride
levels.fix: Short last step, low and firm

levels.name: Hesitate, push out, cross
levels.how: Dribble at a mannequin, a little hesitation, push the ball out at 45 degrees, then cross into the zone between the 6-yard box and the penalty spot. Mix whipped and lofted.
levels.fix: Hesitate, push it out, then cross at pace

levels.name: Goal-line cut-back
levels.how: Dribble explosively to the goal line, head up, then cut back along the ground. It buys time for runners.
levels.fix: Head up, cut it low into the zone

source.label: 3 crossing techniques (YouTube Unisport); winger session (YouTube 7mlc)

levels.name: Wall first-time cross
levels.how: Stand 8 to 10 m from the wall at an angle. Pass firmly into it and cross the rebound first time at a cone or marked area. Open your body to the target.
levels.mistake: Leaning back so the ball goes high and over
levels.fix: Standing foot beside the ball, chest over it

levels.name: Cut-back from the corner
levels.how: Line up balls at the corner of the 6-yard box near the byline. Cross or cut back to cone targets on the penalty spot and the far post. Technique through repetition.
levels.mistake: Hitting every ball to the same target
levels.fix: Alternate the targets

levels.name: Cone weave, then cross
levels.how: Weave 4 to 6 cones down the wing, take a set-up touch out of the last cone, look up once and cross to cone targets in the box.
levels.mistake: Crossing with the ball under the body
levels.fix: Push the last touch slightly forward and wide

levels.name: First touch, then cross
levels.how: Receive a pass from the wall, take one touch out of your feet towards the byline, then cross.
levels.fix: One touch out of your feet, then cross

levels.name: 1v1 to cross
levels.how: A cone is the defender. Dribble at it, beat it with a move to the outside, then cross.
levels.fix: Beat it first, then look up and cross

levels.name: Give-and-go to cross
levels.how: Play a one-two off the wall (the wall is your teammate), then cross on the run.
levels.mistake: Playing the wall pass too softly
levels.fix: Firm pass, run onto the return, then cross

source.label: C1 to C6 crossing drills (TikTok @cooket5training)

levels.name: Box footwork
levels.how: 4 cones in a box about 5 m apart. Run up, side shuffle, backpedal, side shuffle, then sprint away 5 to 10 yards. Both sides.
levels.fix: Hips low and feet never cross

levels.name: Close down and jockey
levels.how: Sprint to the first cone and close it down, jockey back, run to the next cone and jockey the other way, return, sprint away 5 to 10 yards. Decelerate in the last steps, force it outside, be patient.
levels.fix: Get parallel first and never tackle from behind

levels.name: Jump and recover
levels.how: Run to the cones, jump as high as you can to win the ball in the air, backpedal back. Three reps taking off from the right foot, then three from the left. Jump volume: full days only.
levels.fix: Land on both feet, knees soft, then backpedal

source.label: D1 to D3 (TikTok @prolific.soccer); FIFA Training Centre

families.name: Heading

levels.name: Defensive header technique
levels.how: Stand side-on and create space from your opponent. Jump off both feet for balance when set (one foot when running in), meet the ball at its highest point and snap through it so it goes high and far. Shout so everyone knows it is your ball.
levels.mistake: Heading it back up instead of through it
levels.fix: Meet it at its highest point and snap through

levels.name: Headers against the wall
levels.how: Self-serve and head the ball against the wall. Light ball or a soft ball.
levels.mistake: Heading with the top of the head
levels.fix: Contact with the forehead, eyes open

levels.name: Clearance headers
levels.how: Toss it up and head it high and far, as a defender clearing a cross. Drive it from your neck and back.
levels.fix: Use the neck and back to drive it

levels.name: Attacking headers
levels.how: Head downwards at a goal or target, from a self-toss or a partner's.
levels.fix: Get above the ball and head it down

source.label: Heading drills (TikTok @cooket5training); heading dose: English FA

families.note: At most 10 headers a session and one heading session a week. Use a light ball. Not after a head injury.

families.name: Finishing drills

levels.name: Laces across goal
levels.how: Strike across the keeper into the far side. Chest over the ball, land on the striking foot.
levels.fix: Chest over the ball

levels.name: Skill move to shot
levels.how: Dribble at a cone, do a move, then shoot.
levels.fix: Move at speed, then strike

levels.name: Through ball, finish
levels.how: Pass ahead of yourself through the cones, run onto it and finish.
levels.fix: Weight it so you arrive on it

levels.name: Fake shot to whip
levels.how: Fake the shot, take it across, whip the ball to the far post.
levels.fix: Head up, show the shot, take it across, then whip

levels.name: Half volleys
levels.how: Self-toss and strike on the half volley, low to the ground.
levels.fix: Chest over the ball, strike down through the bounce

levels.name: Inside-foot placement
levels.how: Placement over power, with both feet. A good item for the day before a game.
levels.fix: Side foot, low, into the corner

levels.name: Whip to the far corner
levels.how: Curl the ball into the far corner with the instep.
levels.fix: Wrap the foot around the ball

levels.name: Turn and finish
levels.how: Back to goal, receive off the wall, turn and shoot.
levels.fix: Scan, turn on the first touch, shoot

levels.name: Wall first-time finish
levels.how: Pass into the wall at an angle and finish the rebound first time into a goal or target.
levels.fix: Hit it first time

levels.name: Called corner
levels.how: The server rolls the ball and calls a corner as you arrive. The app can call LEFT CORNER, RIGHT CORNER, LOW or HIGH on your last touch. Choose late.
levels.fix: Wait for the call, then strike

levels.name: Tight-turn finishing
levels.how: Turn in a tight space, then finish like in a match.
levels.fix: Quick turn, then shoot

source.label: F1 to F11 (TikTok @elevateperformance_, YouTube BallersBasicsTV, Cooper Coaching)

families.note: Miss low and far for rebounds. Follow up every shot.

families.name: Shooting plan

levels.name: Wall shooting
levels.how: Shoot against a wall, as many reps as you can in a timed block. Taxing: 2 to 3 times a week at most.
levels.fix: Stop when the strike goes loose

levels.name: Penalties and free kicks
levels.how: Aim for the corners every time. About 20 to 30 minutes, 2 to 4 times a week.
levels.fix: Pick a corner and commit

levels.name: 1v1 to shot
levels.how: 4 cones in the middle act as a defender: engage, beat, finish. Middle, left and right channels. 6 reps per side with 4 balls.
levels.fix: Use all three channels

levels.name: Box touch to shot
levels.how: A defender on your back. Touch out left or right with different surfaces to create separation, then finish.
levels.fix: Touch out first, then shoot

levels.name: Diamond
levels.how: 4 cones in a diamond. Close control and speed, change direction round the cones, then a 1v1 and a shot in motion. 8 balls, a minute's rest, repeat.
levels.fix: Keep the ball moving at speed

levels.name: Cone maze to 1v1 to shot
levels.how: A cluster of cones: close control and creativity in traffic, then a 1v1 and a shot.
levels.fix: Head up as you leave the maze

levels.name: Positional shooting
levels.how: Play as you would in your position (a winger wide), engage and disengage 1v1s, create your own shot with no restrictions.
levels.fix: Create the shot the way you would in a match

source.label: 7-drill shooting plan (YouTube ZTH Training)

families.note: High-volume shooting 2 to 3 days a week at most.

levels.name: Foot rules
levels.how: A box of cones. On the right side of the box use the right foot, on the left side the left, either foot in the middle. Follow the passing sequence.
levels.fix: Right side right foot, left side left foot

source.label: Partner passing family 1 (YouTube Become Elite)

levels.name: Outside foot turn
levels.how: Bounce with one foot, bounce with the other, drop back checking your shoulder, then a 90-degree touch back to the start with the outside foot, across the body.
levels.fix: Check your shoulder before every drop

levels.name: Inside foot turn
levels.how: Same pattern. The turning touch is the inside of the foot, popping the ball out and opening the body 90 degrees.
levels.fix: Open the body as the touch goes

levels.name: Outside of the other foot
levels.how: Same pattern with the outside of the other foot.
levels.mistake: Using the same foot every time
levels.fix: Alternate the turning foot

levels.name: Sole roll turn
levels.how: Same pattern. The turning touch is a sole roll, 90 degrees.
levels.fix: Short roll, then play

source.label: Partner passing family 2, #2 to #5 (YouTube Become Elite)

levels.name: Shuffle and bounce
levels.how: Shuffle right and left, bouncing the ball back off the wall with one or two touches.
levels.fix: Stay light and moving

levels.name: One or two touches
levels.how: The app calls ONE or TWO: use that many touches before the bounce back.
levels.mistake: Using the wrong number of touches
levels.fix: Listen, then play exactly that many

levels.name: Turn or man on
levels.how: The app calls TURN (receive on the half-turn, open up and hit a 15 yard pass into a mini goal) or MAN ON (bounce it back).
levels.mistake: Turning when the call is man on
levels.fix: Listen, then play the call

levels.name: Colour call
levels.how: The app calls a colour: after the bounce, touch the ball out towards that cone.
levels.fix: Listen, then touch towards that colour

levels.name: Colour and touches
levels.how: A colour and a number: round that colour's cone with that many touches.
levels.fix: Count them, stay in control

source.label: Partner passing family 3, #6 to #8, #12 to #14, #20, #21 (YouTube Become Elite)

levels.name: Inside, tap back outside
levels.how: Receive with the inside of the foot, a small body feint, tap back with the outside of the same foot. The basics, mastered.
levels.fix: Receive and play in one move

levels.name: Inside, tap back with the other
levels.how: Receive with the inside of one foot, tap back with the outside of the other.
levels.mistake: Using the wrong foot to return
levels.fix: Receive with one, return with the other

levels.name: Inside receive, inside pass
levels.how: Receive with the inside of one foot, then an inside pass with the other. Snap the ball across quickly, a little deception, the same weight.
levels.fix: Same weight every time

source.label: Partner passing family 4, #9 to #11 (YouTube Become Elite)

levels.name: Foot follows direction
levels.how: A T of cones. One touch everywhere except two touches at the back of the T. Going right, use the right foot.
levels.mistake: Using the wrong foot for the direction
levels.fix: Right foot going right, left foot going left

levels.name: Turn behind
levels.how: At the back of the T take a touch and turn 45 degrees behind you, out to the side.
levels.fix: Open your hips as you take the touch

levels.name: Scuffed ball
levels.how: At the back of the T the partner scuffs the pass to shin or knee height. Kill it, control it fast and play back.
levels.mistake: Letting it bounce off the shin
levels.fix: Cushion it and control it in one move

source.label: Partner passing family 5, #15 to #17 (YouTube Become Elite)

levels.name: Half-turn, 180 degree pass
levels.how: Bounce the first pass, pop the ball a few yards wide, receive on the half-turn, then hit a 10 to 15 yard pass. Simple, and game-realistic at the pro level.
levels.fix: Open up before the ball arrives

levels.name: Half-turn, 90 degree pass
levels.how: The same, but the pass comes from the side, at 90 degrees instead of 180.
levels.fix: Open to the side the pass comes from

source.label: Partner passing family 6, #18, #19 (YouTube Become Elite)

levels.name: Two touches, bounce, high steps
levels.how: At the back cone two touches to kill the ball, play back, a one-touch bounce, then high steps through three cones.
levels.fix: Move straight into the high steps

levels.name: Touch inside the cone
levels.how: The same, but take the touch inside the cone.
levels.mistake: Taking the touch outside the cone
levels.fix: Take it inside the cone

levels.name: Check away, plant, check back
levels.how: Check away, plant beside a marked circle, check back, return with one or two touches, varying each time.
levels.fix: Disguise it: check away, then check to the ball

levels.name: Check and combine
levels.how: Add a short touch-and-pass sequence behind the circle after the check.
levels.fix: Check, then combine at the right speed

source.label: Partner passing family 7, #22 to #25 (YouTube Become Elite)

families.name: Change of direction

levels.name: 505 turn
levels.how: A start line, a turn line 15 m away and a timing cone 5 m before it. Sprint, turn 180 degrees on the turn line, sprint 5 m back through the cone. Do both turning legs. Modified: a 5 m approach.
levels.mistake: Planting hard on the last step only
levels.fix: Brake a step early: slam on the brakes

levels.name: T-drill
levels.how: 4 cones in a T. Sprint to the middle cone, shuffle to one side cone and touch it, shuffle across to the other, back to the middle, backpedal home. Classic layout: 10 yards up, 5 yards either side of the middle.
levels.mistake: Crossing the feet in the shuffle
levels.fix: Stay low and shuffle without crossing

levels.name: Box drill
levels.how: A square of 4 cones. Sprint, shuffle, backpedal, shuffle around the box. The same layout as the defender box.
levels.fix: Square corners, quick feet

levels.name: Non-stop change of direction
levels.how: 2 cones 5 big steps apart. Change direction continuously from side to side, always facing the same way. 4 x 45 s (2 with the ball, 2 without).
levels.fix: Always face the direction of travel

levels.name: Double change
levels.how: Follow the cones and make 2 cuts at full speed. 4 each side, 2 with the ball, 2 without, 6 reps per set.
levels.fix: Full speed in, brake, push the ground away

levels.name: M changes
levels.how: Cones in an M. Sharp cuts at each cone, staying as close to the cones as you can. The tight-spaces drill.
levels.fix: Hug the cones, cut sharply

levels.name: Deceleration box
levels.how: A 4 x 4 yard box and a stop gate 5 yards out. Do the agility pattern in the box, sprint 5 yards and stop dead between the gate cones. Patterns: triangles, up and back with circles or a figure 8, a Z. Left and right.
levels.fix: Slam on the brakes and stop dead

levels.name: Reactive cuts
levels.how: At the cut cone the app calls LEFT or RIGHT, so you cannot plan the cut. Advanced: only after the 45 to 90 degree cuts feel easy.
levels.fix: React to the call, push the ground away

source.label: K1, K2, K5, K7 to K9, K12, K15 (Dos'Santos 2019, Lockie 2017; YouTube Cooper Coaching, Futbol Fit)

families.note: Cues: slam on the brakes, push the ground away, face the direction of travel.

families.name: Sprint layouts

levels.name: Illinois
levels.how: A 10 x 5 m rectangle of 4 cones and 4 cones down the middle, 3.3 m apart. Sprint 10 m and turn, weave the middle cones up and back, sprint 10 m, turn and sprint to the finish. About 12 to 18 s a rep: partly conditioning, full days only.
levels.fix: Go round every cone

levels.name: Zig-zag sprints
levels.how: 4 cones in a zig-zag, 5 m apart, and the last cone 10 m beyond the 4th. Sprint to cone 1, zig-zag through, then accelerate the final 10 m.
levels.fix: Drop the shoulder and explode out

levels.name: Shuttles
levels.how: Lines at 5, 10 and 15 m. Run 0-5-0, 0-10-0, 0-15-0, touching each line with alternating hands.
levels.fix: Brake a step early and turn low

levels.name: Weave to zig-zag
levels.how: A straight line of cones, then a zig-zag. Weave the straight line, then go straight into the zig-zag. 4 sets of 7.
levels.fix: Keep the speed through the transition

levels.name: Fast feet to change
levels.how: Fast feet over a line of cones, sprint to the cone ahead on the same side, then cut straight to the last cone. 8 sets of 6.
levels.fix: Quick light feet, then a hard sprint

levels.name: Curved sprint
levels.how: Sprint along an arc, a 20 to 30 m arc of cones or the penalty-box D. Maintain your speed. About 85 percent of match sprints are curved. Both directions.
levels.fix: Lean into the curve and keep the speed

levels.name: Partner 3-cone race
levels.how: 3 cones a few metres apart. Two players race the same pattern side by side with low, sharp cuts.
levels.fix: Low, sharp cuts

source.label: K3, K4, K6, K10, K11, K13, K14 (Coaches Insider, STATSports, Caldbeck, TikTok @lq_strengthcoach)

families.note: At least one true max-speed run a week: the curved sprint or a flying 20.

levels.name: Come short, spin in behind
levels.how: Start away from the ball, check short to drag the defender, bounce the pass back and spin into the space behind. Solo: 10 m from a wall, check 2 to 3 steps, pass, spin and sprint 10 to 15 m to a cone.
levels.mistake: Checking short with no change of pace
levels.fix: Check, drag the defender, then spin and go

levels.name: Come short, pull wide
levels.how: Check short, bounce it back, then peel away wide to isolate the defender 1v1.
levels.fix: Check first, then peel

levels.name: Come short, curve inside
levels.how: Bounce it back, sell the wide run, then curve inside to attack the space while staying onside.
levels.fix: Curve the run and stay onside

levels.name: Check away, check to
levels.how: Disguise it: check away, then check to the ball, at an angle into the gaps. Check your shoulder. A diagonal run gets a straight pass; a straight run gets a diagonal pass.
levels.mistake: Checking the same way each time
levels.fix: Check away, then to the ball

levels.name: 2v1 to 2v2
levels.how: With 4 to 5 players. Phase 1: 2v1 with a bounce player, create space after the pass. Phase 2: 2v2, never on the same line as your teammate. Phase 3: score only in their half. Phase 4: first-time finishes only.
levels.fix: Create space with a movement after the pass

levels.name: Blind-side run
levels.how: Approach the defender on their blind side so they are between facing you and facing the ball. The moment they turn to look at the ball, cut across them.
levels.fix: Stay behind them, then cut across

levels.name: Near-post fake run
levels.how: Leave the defender one way with a fake run, then change direction quickly to attack the near post and finish.
levels.fix: Sell the fake, then explode

levels.name: Bounce and run in behind
levels.how: With the defender on your back, play a bounce pass to drag them out, then run into the space left behind and finish.
levels.fix: Pass, then go straight into the space

source.label: O1 to O8 (TikTok @the_jwl, @training121; YouTube Pelota Academy; Sport Session Planner)

families.name: Conditioning

levels.name: Repeated sprints 5-15
levels.how: 5 s sprint, 15 s rest. 2 sets of 6 sprints.
levels.mistake: Slowing down in the later sprints
levels.fix: Stop the set when your speed drops

levels.name: Repeated sprints 5-30
levels.how: 5 s sprint, 30 s rest. 2 sets of 6 sprints.
levels.fix: Full 30 s, sprint every one hard

levels.name: Speed endurance
levels.how: 4 sprints of 15 s with 75 s of recovery, twice a week.
levels.fix: Hold your speed to the end of every sprint

levels.name: Dribble intervals 20/10
levels.how: Dribble between cones, 20 s on and 10 s off, 8 rounds (4 minutes a block). Indoors or out.
levels.fix: Full effort for the 20 s

source.label: RSA protocols (PMC5310862, PMC11622046); BM2 (YouTube Coach Hafid Arellano)

families.note: Full days only, never the day before a game, and always last in the session.

levels.name: 2v1 to 2v2
levels.how: A grid with two small goals at each end. Two attackers v one defender; a second defender sprints round the goal and recovers into a 2v2. First defender delays, the recovering defender communicates and picks up the free runner.
levels.fix: Delay until help arrives

levels.name: Recovery to goal side
levels.how: Defenders run to get goal side. A point to the defender for forcing the attacker out or clearing past halfway, a point to the attacker for a goal.
levels.fix: Run to goal side first

levels.name: 3v2 overload
levels.how: 3 pairs of cones, each attacker matched with a defender. The attackers make a 3v2 while the defenders delay, talk and stay compact until support arrives.
levels.fix: Stay compact and talk

source.label: RR1 to RR3 (YouTube At7letic, Cincy SC, Grassroots Football UK)

levels.name: Sprint into a duel
levels.how: Each player completes two passes, then sprints round a cone. A ball is played in; the first player there attacks the big goal, the other defends and counters into the mini goals. A goal earns a bonus ball.
levels.fix: Win the race, then attack at once

levels.name: Finish, recover, 1v1
levels.how: Two lanes. A slaloms the cones and beats a mannequin; B weaves the poles and shoots far post. B then turns into a 1v1 against A. Defender: close down before the attacker gets going. Swap lanes.
levels.fix: Eyes up out of the last cone, shoot early

source.label: V2, V3 (YouTube Coach to Coach, TotalFootball Studio)
